text:
kevin_cs: FYI SunVector just filed a formal onboarding request for a customer-provided 13B fine-tuned model. They want a Private (VPC) deployment with HSM-managed keys, PII/PHI redaction in the ingest pipeline, and a custom eval suite focused on legal Q&A. Target: ~30 qps, ~200 tokens avg, p50 latency SLO 250ms. Can eng + ML weigh in on compatibility and risks?

jamie_se: thanks — quick clarifying q's: are they expecting us to host the control plane or fully private with customer infra? also do they need near-real-time streaming?

kevin_cs: customer asked for Private with our control plane + customer VPC peering (standard model). They explicitly required HSM for key custody and HIPAA-ish language in contract. Streaming not required, single-response sync is fine. They did ask for quantized weights to reduce cost.

anita_ml: ok. for a 13B FT model we need to confirm quantization path (llm.int8 vs 4-bit). if they supply a PT checkpoint we should run conversion + sanity eval. ask them for ~500 labeled prompts (legal Q&A + redaction cases). can someone get sample dataset?

sophie_security: noted. HSM/KMS: we support AWS KMS + external HSM via PKCS11. need their vendor and certs. for PHI/PII we recommend two-layer approach: pre-ingest scrub (customer-side) + server-side redaction hooks. we also require data flow diagram and retention policy for legal signoff.

jamie_se: perf notes: 30 qps @200 tokens -> with batching we'll need to size for concurrency. On private infra with quantized int8 on 1x A100 80GB might be borderline; recommend 2x GPUs or a vCPU-backed burst policy. If they want single-GPU cost target, 4-bit quant + flash-attention kernels could work on H100/RTX6000.

kevin_cs: putting together a checklist for the enablement call: 1) sample prompts/dataset, 2) model file + sha256, 3) HSM vendor + network allowlist, 4) retention policy + RTP, 5) eval targets (EM/ROUGE/hallucination). I'm proposing a Tuesday 11:00am PT sync with SunVector + eng + security. is that okay?

anita_ml: works for me. i'll draft an eval harness template and a short prompt set for hallucination tests. will include a small runner we can ask them to run first.

jamie_se: i'll prepare quantization guidance and a private-deploy runbook. will call out hardware options and estimated cost ranges.

sophie_security: i'll need the data flow diagram before the call. also cc legal for HIPAA language — @sarah_legal will need to approve the retention bits.

infra-bot: Ticket created: CS-8421 SunVector 13B private/HSM onboarding. Owner: unassigned. Priority: P2. Link: https://redwood.internal/cs/tickets/CS-8421

kevin_cs: assigning next steps: @jamie_se -> quant guide + runbook; @anita_ml -> eval harness + prompt template; @sophie_security -> HSM checklist + legal contact. i'll schedule the call and share the Deck + pre-call doc: <https://redwood.internal/onboarding/playbooks/sunvector-13b>.

jamie_se: one more thing — can the customer confirm whether weights are already quantized? if not we'll need a prep window to run conversion and regression evals.

kevin_cs: asked them in DM, they replied: "weights are full fp16, not quantized". so plan for conversion step.

anita_ml: sample eval snippet i'll share in the doc:```
./eval_runner --model /mnt/models/llama-13b-ft \\\n  --prompts sunvector_prompts.json \\\n  --batch 16 --max-tokens 200 --output eval.json

# example metrics (mock):
# exact_match: 0.71
# rouge_l: 0.62
# hallucination_rate: 0.04
```

kevin_cs: perfect. i'll ping the customer with proposed times and add CS-8421 to our renewal watchlist (renewal risk flagged until successful onboarding + HIPAA signoff).

jamie_se: cool. i'll add a short checklist to the runbook for fallback models in case the quantized conversion regresses -> recommend a canary with smaller prompt set.

sophie_security: noted. will schedule legal review after we get the data flow doc.

kevin_cs: thanks team — i'll update this thread after the call is locked. :thumbsup:
